name: pnp-sharepoint-skills-decision-register-builder
title: Decision Register Builder
shortDescription: Discovers and maintains an evidence-based SharePoint project Decision Register.
longDescription: Analyzes project documents and structured SharePoint lists to identify explicit decisions, unresolved decision requirements, proposals, deferrals, and superseding decisions.
The skill discovers an existing Decision Register, preserves existing IDs, avoids duplicate decisions, respects reporting cut-offs, and can generate a standalone HTML5 management report.
